notes: 'Junior 4' is NYC jargon for a 1-bedroom plus a windowed dining alcove (4 rooms total). Correct beds = 1 (some agents market it as a flex-2). The failure is reading the '4' as 4 bedrooms.

input.subject: No-Fee Junior 4 in Murray Hill — Prewar Doorman, Avail Now
input.bodyText:
Hi all,

Just picked up a great rental listing at 155 East 34th St, right in the heart of Murray Hill.

It's a classic prewar Junior 4 — so you've got the one bedroom plus a windowed dining alcove off the living room that a lot of my clients use as a home office or flex space. Some folks market these as a flex-2, but to be clear it's a true 1BR layout with the extra windowed room.

Details:
- $3,800/mo
- Prewar building, beautiful details, high ceilings
- Full-time doorman
- NO FEE
- Available now

Easy to show this week — let me know if you have anyone.

Best,
Danielle Ferraro
Corcoran
